description: This file defines Slack socket reconnection policies, error handling, and event management functions for Slack API integration, including error detection, socket event handling, and disconnect waiting logic.

methods.name: getSocketEmitter
methods.description: Retrieves an emitter-like object from the app, allowing event subscription and removal for Slack socket events.

methods.name: waitForSlackSocketDisconnect
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the Slack socket disconnects or an abort signal is triggered.

methods.name: isNonRecoverableSlackAuthError
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a non-recoverable Slack authentication error.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object into a string message.
